english.title: Food business operator in Wales fail to list items in relevant food that could cause allergy or intolerance
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a food business operator in Wales, failed to comply with Article 9(1)(c) of Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 relating to the provision of food information in relation to an ingredient or processing aid causing allergies or intolerance in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(1)(a), (2)(a) and 11 of the Food Information (Wales) Regulations 2014.
